description: This file contains implementations of various vision models and utilities, including ResNet variants, DETR, FCN, and related functions for object detection and segmentation, with references to torchvision and PyTorch.

classes.name: BasicBlock
classes.description: A basic residual block used in ResNet architectures, supporting convolutional layers, batch normalization, and ReLU activation.

classes.name: Bottleneck
classes.description: A bottleneck residual block with 1x1 and 3x3 convolutions, used in deeper ResNet models.

classes.name: ResNet
classes.description: Implementation of ResNet architecture with configurable layers, blocks, and normalization.

classes.name: IntermediateLayerGetter
classes.description: Utility module to extract intermediate features from a model based on specified layer names.

classes.name: FCN
classes.description: Fully convolutional network class for semantic segmentation, extending a simple segmentation model.

classes.name: FCNHead
classes.description: Head module for FCN, consisting of convolution, batch norm, ReLU, dropout, and final convolution layers.

classes.name: DETR
classes.description: Implementation of the Detection Transformer (DETR) model for object detection, including backbone, transformer, and prediction heads.

classes.name: SetCriterion
classes.description: Loss computation class for DETR, including Hungarian matching, box and class losses, and auxiliary losses.

classes.name: HungarianMatcher
classes.description: Performs optimal assignment between predicted and ground-truth objects using the Hungarian algorithm.

methods.name: conv3x3
methods.description: Creates a 3x3 convolution layer with padding, no bias.

methods.name: conv1x1
methods.description: Creates a 1x1 convolution layer, no bias.

methods.name: ResNet._make_layer
methods.description: Constructs a sequential layer of residual blocks with specified parameters.

methods.name: ResNet._forward_impl
methods.description: Internal method to define the forward pass of ResNet.

methods.name: fcn_resnet50
methods.description: Builds a FCN model with ResNet-50 backbone for semantic segmentation.

methods.name: generalized_box_iou
methods.description: Calculates the generalized IoU between two sets of boxes.

methods.name: box_cxcywh_to_xyxy
methods.description: Converts bounding boxes from center-x, center-y, width, height format to x1, y1, x2, y2 format.

methods.name: box_area
methods.description: Computes the area of bounding boxes.

methods.name: box_iou
methods.description: Calculates IoU and union for two sets of boxes.

methods.name: accuracy
methods.description: Computes top-k accuracy for model outputs.

methods.name: SetCriterion.forward
methods.description: Computes the total loss for DETR, including matching and auxiliary losses.

methods.name: HungarianMatcher.forward
methods.description: Performs optimal assignment between predictions and targets using the Hungarian algorithm.
